$note: A Semi style: the look every component reads. tokens = shape, card border, fonts, control sizes; semantic = neutral surface / text / line colours per theme (accent, status and tone colours stay shared). Every style sets the same token keys; semantic keys are optional overrides of tokens/tokens.json. fonts = what the app loads with next/font. Edit, then npm run build:tokens. docs/STYLES.md describes each style.
name: Sharp
description: Pure black and white, strong 2px borders, square corners, a hard offset shadow, Space Grotesk. Bold, editorial screens: landing pages, portfolios, creative tools.

shadow-card.note: Hard offset shadow in the strong line colour

font-sans.value: var(--font-sans-family, var(--font-space-grotesk)), "Space Grotesk", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", sans-serif
